name: Dive's Instruction Manual procs on direct damage (#12286)
contract: #12286: Dive's Instruction Manual (proc dummies 304075, 313109, 317109, 321109) never procced. Every dummy
carries Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it.
Tooltip: "Dealing direct damage". Flags 69972 (every direct damage source: melee and ranged auto attacks and
abilities, and harmful spells) as the merged T1 Paladin 6-piece row for "Dealing damage". No cooldown in any
tooltip. spell_proc_chance reads each loaded entry's chance, which equals the record's ProcChance, and
spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded cooldown. aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision,
including the roll, 40000 times on one synthetic event per check. It procs on a landed melee auto attack, a
landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78), a landed ranged auto attack, a landed ranged ability (Arcane Shot
3044), a landed direct magic spell (Frostbolt 116), at the record's chance; it never procs on a periodic
Fire tick (Immolate 348), a direct heal (Flash Heal 2061). Before the repair the chance and cooldown lookups
fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail instead of
